description: This file defines functions for creating, removing, enlisting, and initializing a BroadWay Web Resource Manager (BWRM) Environment Controller Object, including associated memory allocation, object management, and interface setup.

classes.name: BWRM_ENV_CONTROLLER_OBJECT
classes.description: Struct representing the Environment Controller Object instance with member fields for object management, interfaces, properties, and locks.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE BwrmEcoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new BWRM Environment Controller Object, setting up function pointers and internal state.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwrmEcoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the Environment Controller Object, freeing allocated resources and cleaning up internal references.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwrmEcoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls associated sub-objects such as RAM interface, file manager, and page manager, initializing them if necessary.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwrmEcoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the Environment Controller Object's member variables, function pointers, and internal state, preparing it for use.
